hooks.command: h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.py"; p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -f "$p" ] || p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then "$p" "$h"; else uv run --no-project --quiet python "$h"; fi

h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/stop_pytest.py"; p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -f "$p" ] || p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then "$p" "$h"; else uv run --no-project --quiet python "$h"; fi

h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/session_start.py"; p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -f "$p" ] || p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then "$p" "$h"; else uv run --no-project --quiet python "$h"; fi
